responsibility: Provides the AIX 6.1-specific rs6000 subtarget configuration layered on top of the generic AIX/XCOFF support. It defines AIX 6.1 option-override rules and diagnostics for 32/64-bit mode, PowerPC64, soft-float versus long-double-128, and TOC/code-model combinations; selects assembler CPU mappings and defaults; sets AIX 6.1 preprocessor builtins, library/link/startfile specs, and ABI-relevant type choices such as ptrdiff_t and wchar_t; and enables versioned capabilities like Altivec/VSX support and large-TOC code-model handling for this OS release.
